text:
Marco: FYI Evergreen just asked for our SOC 2 "evidence snapshot" + a short bridge note so they can kick off a POC. they want a presigned link to a PDF. can we hand that over before an NDA?
Priya: evergreen is asking for a 48h turnaround. sales preference is to get something lightweight to unblock the POC. curious what legal/security need.
Zoe (Legal): standard practice: we require a signed NDA before we issue presigned links to internal artifacts. we can, however, provide a redacted PDF summary (controls matrix + cover page) without a presigned URL, if that's acceptable. i'll draft an NDA and a minimal bridge-letter template. need the client legal contact to send.
Ibrahim (Security): technical constraints: any snapshot must strip PII, internal IAM usernames, service account emails, and IPs. redaction checklist: remove GUIDs, truncate request IDs, scrub raw logs. Bridge language should avoid attestation beyond "no exceptions observed for scope X during period Y."
DocsBot: Reminder: policy SOC-SHARE-02 requires tagging artifacts with `sensitive:soc2` and using presign expiry <= 7 days. See: https://internal.redwood/policies/soc2-sharing
Marco: client contact is legal@evergreen.co. they specifically asked "can the bridge say full Type II is clean?"
Zoe (Legal): we can't say "full Type II is clean" unless they sign an NDA and we hand over the full report to an authorized reviewer with an audit handling addendum. the bridge can only say what ops validates (e.g., "no exceptions identified in the scoped artifacts dated 2025-11-30").
Priya: timeline check: if we get NDA signed today can we get a redacted snapshot + presigned link in <48h?
Ibrahim (Security): yes, engineering can assemble the snapshot in ~24h once scope is signed off. presign creation command: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2/evergreen-snapshot-2026.pdf --expires-in 604800` (we'll set expiry to 7 days max). but we will only generate after legal confirms NDA is executed.
Zoe (Legal): i'll send NDA + bridge-letter draft to legal@evergreen.co and cc priya. i'll include required language about redactions and access controls.
Marco: cool. action items: Zoe send NDA + draft; Ibrahim prepare redaction checklist and scope; Priya to nudge Evergreen for signature. i'll update thread when they reply. :rocket:
Ibrahim (Security): starting the redaction checklist now. will also confirm logs retention status.
Priya: pinged client. thanks team.
Marco: thanks all.
